reviews.t: It does do the job AS LONG as you have mascara on
reviews.x: The first time I tried this product I gave it a bad review as I used it prior to putting mascara on and it didn’t work, however, I changed my mind today. I put on my mascara and then used this curler, and it made a huge difference. I highly recommend!

I read a few reviews that got me to purchase this thing, but I have huge regrets.  It does curl your eyelashes, but if you have small straight thin eyelashes, you can barely tell.  It's a very small curl, nothing like you would get with a standard eye lash curler.  It also takes 6 minutes for me to curl my lashes with this.  I've tried both ways, with mascara and without.  It's not the easiest to clean so I don't recommend with mascara.  The only plus is it doesn't rip out your eye lashes but ov

I don't wear makeup that often and I really hate the eyelash curlers that crimp your lashes. This curler heats and curls quickly with or without mascara.  I've used this mostly without mascara to give my natural lashes a girl in the morning. The guard keeps you from burning your eyelid. Overall I would purchase again because the price is comperable to a regular eyelash curler, and it does the job well without me accidentally pulling out lashes in the process.

reviews.t: Not effective for my already slightly curled lashes
reviews.x: I didn’t realize this item came straight from China ( although it was obviously in stock in the US). There is Chinese writing on the box and the directions were obviously with translated (pretty well) or written by someone who didn’t know Englis as well as they should.  The product arrives nicely packaged in a nice box.  Battery is not included.  I thought the ridges of the heating element would be longer to act as more of a comb. They are not.  You are pushing the lashes with this - not combing

It does curl your eyelashes and it is for sure better than using a typical eyelash curler. The heat is very gentle and has two settings, even on the hottest setting it takes a while to get a curl going.  I found that this was best way to get long thick eyelash curl: 1. take a clean mascara wand and dip it in hair gel 2. apply hair gel to your eyelashes 3. while they are still wet with hair gel curl them with the heated eyelash curler 4. Repeated this like two times and then applied mascara as yo

I’ve had a different brand for the last year that worked very well, but died after 1 year of use. I purchased this as a replacement but it doesn’t work nearly as well! I don’t think it gets hot enough to curl my lashes. Disappointing.
After mascara this curls lashes up very well

I love this eye lash curler. Its so easy to use and you dont have to worry about pulling out eyelashes with this. I get good results everytime. My best recommandation is to use this after you put mascara on and let it dry a little bit. Dont go in right away after you have just put the mascara on because then it tends to look a bit clumpy. The only complaint i have about this product is it seems to go through batteries very fast. Other then that its a great product!

I purchased this not knowing what to expect,  but I rather like it! It saves my eyelashes from the standard eyelash curler I had been using. Not loosing eyelashes nearly as much from breakage. Easy to use. Light weight Color pink and white Take 1 triple A battery Would definitely recommend

The packaging was great. I got it very quickly.  I used this several times and loved it. My daughter wanted to try it and now she won't give it back... guess I'll be buying a second one. It heats up quickly and there's no way you are going to get burned.
Worls great, easy to use, and curls lashes perfect! Tried without mascara on first as directed, but you can definitely use after too! Helped a few lashes that lost its curl too! Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Does not work am straight lashes
reviews.x: Does nothing to my lashes, but I have impossibly straight Asian lashes that only respond to eyelash curlers. I was hoping this would be a gentler alternative, but that was not the case.
Piece of Chinese throw-away. On off switch somehow not right. Disappointed! Total waste..... if had seen at Dollar Store, would have passed it up.
I was really upset when I put a battery in and waited to use it, but it didn't heat up. I sent it back. Don't waste your money.
Good idea except mine did not work it kept killing the battery before I could curl my eyelashes
Save your time and money and don’t buy this

Yep. I love it. I HAVE eyelashes, they just don't grow "up" so you can't see them. Hold this contraption on your eyelashes for 10-15 seconds, and like a little eyelash curling iron it will curl them. As other reviewers have said, make sure you apply mascara first, it acts as a glue and makes the thing work. Once, I forgot to turn the eyelash curler off when I went to work and it did not burn the house down - it powered down by itself. If you are not an idiot like myself, you can put the cap back

reviews.x: I love these eyelash curler! I've had them for about a month and I use them everyday. The curl lasts all day long. They take a few minutes to heat. I use them prior to applying mascara and then once after and you can really tell the difference in your eyelashes. There's no pain at all. You can't feel the heat units. The new one has two distinct settings that work at different temperatures.  Very pleased.  It doesn't heat up enough to produce curl.  My eyelashes are very fine, and it doesn't take much, but this hardly heats at all on the high setting.  The low setting could also be called "room temperature."  This is the third, most expensive,

I researched eye lash curlers for a couple of weeks and decided I wanted a heated one. I did a search for best curlers and this one came out on top. I have been very pleased with how easy it is to use and the way it works curling my lashes and helping to train them do that they are straighter - they usually go sideways. I curl them, add a layer of mascara and then curl them again. It works beautifully on my upper and lower lashes. It deserves the great reviews and being on top of the list.

reviews.t: Great url but doesnt seem to hold long
reviews.x: I was skeptical but it heated quickly amd curls well! I followed instructions to use mascara prior to use. The device is small so I feel the cost is slightly pricey but it seems to be good quality. Con is that its battery operated. I feel a plug in charger would be better for my needs but I'm sure this device doesnt use much power and thus the battery should last a while.  Edit: I'm not sure if it's something I'm doing wrong but it seems the curl doesn't hold long.

1. The packaging was damaged and the cap was broke. I didn't think that would matter if the product worked... 2. This product does not work. It does not "curl" your lashes. In fact, it might make them MORE straight.  I typically will heat my normal eyelash curler and then curl my lashes...I thought this would be an easier and safer way, but it totally doesn't work...I'd give it 0-stars if I could. Don't waste your money...returning the product.

I absolutely love the curve in the wand. It makes it so much easier to curl out your lashes than with a straight heated eyelash wand. It does a great job. Only downside is it being battery operated. But that's not enough to make me lower the score to anything but the 5 stars I gave it because it does a great job and if you don't forget to turn it off when you're done with it, then the battery should last you a fair amount of time.

reviews.t: Love my electric eye lash curler!!
reviews.x: My eyelashes tend to stick straight out, not up. Every time I used a traditional lash curler, it would pull out a lash or two. It also didn’t do an even curl every time. This electric curler protects your lashes, and curls them well! I followed the instructions, applying a coat of mascara first. Then I curl the lashes. For night, I apply a second coat. It is incredibly easy to use.  Definitely worth the money!

claims.text: Many reviewers say it curls lashes well and works especially after applying mascara.
Several reviewers find it easy to use and gentler than a standard eyelash curler, with a guard that prevents burns and reduces lash breakage.
Some reviewers report it is not effective for straight, thin, or already-curled lashes, producing only a small curl.
A number of reviewers report heating or battery problems, including units that did not heat up or kept draining the battery.
Some reviewers say it does not get hot enough or takes a long time to produce a curl.
